megumi.label: 伏黑惠
megumi.choreography:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset: production HD-2D RPG battle sprite atlas, EXACTLY 16 separate full-body figures in a square 4-column x 4-row grid, ordered row-major. Aim for a 2048 x 2048 canvas with generous empty gutters. Genuine alpha transparency, NOT a painted checkerboard. No scenery, floor, shadows, effects, labels, grid lines or text.
Input image 1 is the ACCEPTED STYLE B: reproduce its refined JRPG pixel-cluster aesthetic and compact expressive anatomy, not its characters or dark background. Input image 2 is the official anime CHARACTER IDENTITY and exact costume reference. Preserve that identity in every frame. This is carefully authored pixel art, visible stepped contours and intentional square clusters, compact roughly 5-head-tall people, restrained 3-4 shades per material, dark navy outlines, readable small pixel faces. No smooth anime ink contours, blurry painted shading, 3D, super-deformed chibi or photorealism. Keep the same pixel density throughout the sheet, finer than classic tiny JRPG sprites but still unmistakably pixel art. Keep the whole body AND weapon inside each cell with generous 12-15 percent side margins. Faces and action aim toward screen RIGHT in three-quarter side view. Full legs, feet, hands and connected limbs must remain readable. Every cell contains exactly ONE same-size character, no fragments outside it, no duplicate character. Small facial details should remain pixels, never oversized anime eyes. Standing feet share a consistent ground baseline. Frames 0,1,2 have IDENTICAL feet and pelvis placement; only subtle breathing, cloth and a blink vary. Do not shift the entire idle body sideways. Attack frames form a coherent windup -> step -> release -> contact -> follow-through -> recovery sequence. No energy painted into the character sheet; game renders effects separately.

Megumi Fushiguro, early school uniform: black spiky hair with his distinctive angular tufts, dark blue eyes, navy high collar with gold button, navy straight trousers and tan ankle boots. No weapon. Both arms and hands are always visibly present, not hidden or cut off. Slim, cautious and serious.
Frames: 0 low side-on ready stance, hands guarding chest, two feet grounded; 1 same foot anchors and small shoulder breath; 2 same pose blinking. 3 chamber the right knee, hands balance; 4 planted rear foot pivots, knee aimed RIGHT; 5 half-extended side kick; 6 fully extended RIGHT side kick with rear foot planted; 7 retract knee; 8 recover both feet and guard. 9 BOTH hands clearly overlap horizontally at chest forming the canonical Divine Dogs shadow-puppet sign, crossed thumbs and dog ears, not a one-handed ninja sign; 10 a DISTINCT canonical Chimera Shadow Garden hand seal: both clenched fists clasped tightly together at chest, leaning forward with focused face (not Gojo's crossed-finger seal); 11 both hands lower after summoning; 12 compact forearm side guard; 13 shoulder-hit recoil with both hands visible; 14 kneeling exhausted, one hand on ground; 15 restrained victory, standing calmly with arms folded. No summoned animals.

Kento Nanami, blond neatly side-parted hair, characteristic small green-lensed goggles with pale frame, beige suit, BLUE collared shirt, mustard spotted tie, brown dress shoes. Mature angular face, restrained adult proportions, precise professional posture. His weapon is his SHORT blunt cleaver tightly wrapped in pale patterned cloth, NOT a giant sword or a katana. Weapon remains physically held and fits inside each cell.
Frames: 0 upright precise guard with wrapped cleaver lowered in right hand and free left hand near tie; 1 same feet, subtle breath and tie movement; 2 same stance blink behind goggles. 3 cleaver drawn back diagonally near right shoulder; 4 measured step forward; 5 torso rotates starting downward diagonal cut; 6 decisive diagonal cleaver contact toward RIGHT; 7 controlled follow-through, no wild overswing; 8 reset cleaver near waist. 9 left hand adjusts tie, cleaver still low in right hand preparing Overtime; 10 both shoulders set, sharp focused Ratio Technique ready pose with weapon forward, no spell gesture; 11 returns weapon to low guard. 12 short blade diagonal guard across torso; 13 tight shoulder recoil without dropping weapon; 14 exhausted one-knee crouch, cleaver held down; 15 relaxed victory adjusting tie and holding the cleaver. Suit, goggles and weapon consistent in all frames.

EARLY Maki Zenin only: dark green high ponytail, straight bangs, rectangular purple glasses, navy high-collar jacket and matching skirt, dark stockings and black ankle boots. Preserve the official reference costume, not her later short-haired/scarred form. Her cursed tool is the reference's LONG red-brown shaft naginata/polearm with silver curved blade and small red/pale tassel. Both hands firmly grip the shaft; do not make it a katana. Athletic sharp confident face.
Frames: 0 low two-handed polearm ready diagonally, whole blade and butt inside cell; 1 same feet and tiny shoulder breath, ponytail tips move; 2 same pose blink. 3 shaft pulled back low, knee bends; 4 forward foot step, shaft parallel to aim; 5 arms drive shaft forward; 6 full two-handed polearm thrust toward RIGHT; 7 short controlled lateral sweeping follow-through; 8 pull shaft back to ready. 9 raise polearm above head in two hands, athletic overhead windup; 10 heavy downward diagonal polearm cleave toward RIGHT; 11 recover the weapon down across body. 12 braced two-handed shaft block across torso; 13 stagger with both hands maintaining grip; 14 exhausted low kneeling, polearm close to body; 15 confident victory with polearm resting diagonally by shoulder. These are physical weapon techniques, no magical hand signs, no domain.

Yuta Okkotsu, regular school form: distinctive asymmetric black fringe, tired gentle eyes and subtle under-eye shadows, WHITE high-collar jacket with asymmetrical gold button, loose black trousers, white sneakers. Do not substitute navy uniform, later hair or bandages. Standard slim katana with dark hilt, carried in right hand and controlled by both hands during cuts. Small ring on LEFT ring finger. Nervous restrained readiness, determined during action. No Rika drawn in this atlas.
Frames: 0 cautious two-handed katana guard at waist, blade angled forward RIGHT; 1 same feet, shoulder breath; 2 same stance blink. 3 katana lowered left across hips preparing rising slash; 4 short forward step with blade still low; 5 upward blade release; 6 two-handed rising diagonal katana contact toward RIGHT; 7 raised blade follow-through; 8 blade lowered, feet returned to cautious guard. 9 LEFT ring hand lifts toward chest while right hand holds katana safely down; 10 left ring hand extends forward with open fingers to call Rika/cursed-energy action, right hand still on katana, two arms clearly separated; 11 ring hand draws back and sword returns to guard. 12 two-handed sword block angled across front; 13 low torso recoil retaining sword; 14 exhausted kneeling with sword lowered safely; 15 modest victory holding sword low with a small relieved smile. Keep weapon a thin katana, not Nanami's cleaver or Maki's polearm.

mahoraga.label: 魔虚罗
mahoraga.choreography: Exact divine general anatomy from model reference: massive white two-armed muscular body, no normal eyes, FOUR horizontal wing-like eyestalk structures on head, toothed mouth, eight-handled golden wheel above head attached by stalk, dark flowing lower pants, sash, forearm sword and black chest pendant. Canonical wheel and face crucial. Idle sword down and other fist ready; idle2 subtle shoulder/wheel rotation (wheel stays connected), windup raises sword arm, attack heavy downward sword chop, cast left palm with upright wheel, guard sword forearm, defeated crouch still eight wheel handles. Keep wheel/head/sword all in every cell.

jogo.label: 漏壶
jogo.choreography: Jogo squat hunched cyclops curse. Gray skin, single central eye, bald volcano-shaped dark cranial cone, mustard spotted short cape over black clothing, pale scarf and brown mid-calf boots with reddish soles. Faces LEFT. Keep short stature but use consistent sprite scale. 0: hunched walking-stick-like stance with hands curled low, eye glaring; 1: shoulders rise and volcano head tilts, cape shifts; 2: leans far back with both fingers fanned beside volcanic head; 3: thrusts both spread hands low-forward as flame-launch pose, small grounded steps not boxer lunge, no painted fire; 4: raises one gnarled hand skyward to summon volcanic attack, other arm tucked, single eye wide; 5: short stumbling recoil, cape lifts and one foot raised; 6: crouches under cape with forearms protecting volcano head; 7: squats collapsed low with head sagging and legs out, no gore. Never add two eyes or human hair.
